metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in the Leipzig mining region (e.g., Neuseenland) increase in April 2020 compared to April 1987?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Region: Rectangle around Leipzig Neuseenland: [12.1E, 51.1N, 12.6E, 51.4N]. - Primary dataset: JRC Global Surface Water Monthly History (JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory) for April 1987 and April 2020. - Fallback if needed: Landsat L2 SR (LT05 for 1987, LC08 for 2020) with NDWI (MNDWI) and cloud/shadow masking. 2. Masking strategy. - JRC: Already cloud-free; use water class (2 = water). - Landsat fallback: Mask clouds/shadows using QA_PIXEL bits (dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow). Scale SR bands and compute MNDWI; threshold > 0.3 for water. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - If image collections empty after primary and fallback attempts: C1. - If collections exist but valid pixels after masking = 0: C2. - If area is null/NaN or outside [0, region area]: C3. - If obsCount > 0 but water area is null, treat as valid zero water (area = 0). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function getInfoAsync(obj) { return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.getInfo(function(res) { resolve(res); }, function(err) { reject(err); }); }); } function maskLandsatL2(img) { var qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); var clear = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // Dilated cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // Cirrus .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // Cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); // Cloud shadow var sr = img.select('SR_B.*').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); var imgScaled = img.addBands(sr, null, true).updateMask(clear); var green = imgScaled.select(['SR_B3', 'SR_B2']).reduce(ee.Reducer.firstNonNull()); var swir1 = imgScaled.select(['SR_B6', 'SR_B5']).reduce(ee.Reducer.firstNonNull()); var mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('mndwi'); return imgScaled.addBands(mndwi); } async function summarizeJRC(year, geom) { var start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 4, 1); var end = start.advance(1, 'month'); var col = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(geom); var size = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); if (!size || size === 0) return { status: 'missing', sizeJRC: 0 }; var img = ee.Image(col.first()); var water = img.select('water'); var obsMask = water.gt(0).selfMask().rename('obs'); // observed pixels (water or not) var watMask = water.eq(2).selfMask().rename('wat'); // water pixels var obsCount = ee.Image(1).updateMask(obsMask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('constant'); var obsCountVal = await getInfoAsync(obsCount); if (!obsCountVal || obsCountVal === 0) { return { status: 'no_valid_pixels', sizeJRC: size }; } var waterAreaM2 = watMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).rename('wa').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('wa'); var waterAreaM2Val = await getInfoAsync(waterAreaM2); var areaKm2 = (waterAreaM2Val == null ? 0 : waterAreaM2Val) / 1e6; return { status: 'ok', sizeJRC: size, obsCount: obsCountVal, areaKm2: areaKm2 }; } async function summarizeLandsat(year, geom) { var start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 4, 1); var end = start.advance(1, 'month'); var colId = (year < 1999) ? 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2' : (year >= 2013) ? 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2' : 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2'; var col = ee.ImageCollection(colId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom).map(maskLandsatL2); var size = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); if (!size || size === 0) { // Broaden to Mar 1 - Jun 1 as recovery var colBroad = ee.ImageCollection(colId).filterDate(ee.Date.fromYMD(year,3,1), ee.Date.fromYMD(year,6,1)) .filterBounds(geom).map(maskLandsatL2); var sizeB = await getInfoAsync(colBroad.size()); if (!sizeB || sizeB === 0) return { status: 'missing', lsSize: 0 }; col = colBroad; size = sizeB; } var mndwiMed = col.select('mndwi').median().clip(geom); var validCount = mndwiMed.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mndwi'); var validCountVal = await getInfoAsync(validCount); if (!validCountVal || validCountVal === 0) { return { status: 'no_valid_pixels', lsSize: size }; } var waterMask = mndwiMed.gt(0.3).selfMask(); var waterAreaM2 = waterMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).rename('wa').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('wa'); var waterAreaM2Val = await getInfoAsync(waterAreaM2); var areaKm2 = (waterAreaM2Val == null ? 0 : waterAreaM2Val) / 1e6; return { status: 'ok', lsSize: size, obsCount: validCountVal, areaKm2: areaKm2 }; } async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([12.1, 51.1, 12.6, 51.4], null, false); var regionAreaKm2 = (await getInfoAsync(geom.area(1))).valueOf() / 1e6; // 2. Get JRC summaries; fallback to Landsat if missing var jrc1987 = await summarizeJRC(1987, geom); var jrc2020 = await summarizeJRC(2020, geom); console.log(`Region km2: ${regionAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`JRC 1987 Apr Images: ${jrc1987.sizeJRC || 0}`); console.log(`JRC 2020 Apr Images: ${jrc2020.sizeJRC || 0}`); let s1987, s2020, usedJRC1987 = false, usedJRC2020 = false; if (jrc1987.status === 'ok') { s1987 = jrc1987; usedJRC1987 = true; } else if (jrc1987.status === 'no_valid_pixels') { console.log('1987: JRC has 0 valid pixels.'); } else { console.log('1987: JRC missing, trying Landsat.'); } if (jrc2020.status === 'ok') { s2020 = jrc2020; usedJRC2020 = true; } else if (jrc2020.status === 'no_valid_pixels') { console.log('2020: JRC has 0 valid pixels.'); } else { console.log('2020: JRC missing, trying Landsat.'); } if (!s1987) { var ls1987 = await summarizeLandsat(1987, geom); if (ls1987.status === 'missing') { console.log('1987 Landsat: 0 images (even after widening).'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (ls1987.status === 'no_valid_pixels') { console.log('1987 Landsat: No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } s1987 = ls1987; } if (!s2020) { var ls2020 = await summarizeLandsat(2020, geom); if (ls2020.status === 'missing') { console.log('2020 Landsat: 0 images (even after widening).'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (ls2020.status === 'no_valid_pixels') { console.log('2020 Landsat: No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } s2020 = ls2020; } // 3. Validation of results function invalidArea(a) { return (a == null) || isNaN(a) || a < 0 || a > regionAreaKm2 * 1.05; } if (invalidArea(s1987.areaKm2) || invalidArea(s2020.areaKm2)) { console.log('Invalid area result (None/NaN or out of range).'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 4. Report concise stats console.log(`1987 Apr Water km2: ${s1987.areaKm2.toFixed(2)} (Obs: ${s1987.obsCount}) [${usedJRC1987 ? 'JRC' : 'Landsat'}]`); console.log(`2020 Apr Water km2: ${s2020.areaKm2.toFixed(2)} (Obs: ${s2020.obsCount}) [${usedJRC2020 ? 'JRC' : 'Landsat'}]`); var change = s2020.areaKm2 - s1987.areaKm2; console.log(`Change km2 (2020-1987): ${change.toFixed(2)}`); // 5. Final Answer const epsilon = 0.1; // km2 threshold to avoid noise if (change > epsilon) console.log('A'); else console.log('B'); } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
